observations: The checkpoint-integrity unit completed its full O lifecycle and returned to Root.
The current behavioral-outcome mechanism can hide rubrics from child-visible requests and mechanically verify exact answers.
fragment.purpose: Select the next smallest falsifiable behavioral unit after checkpoint durability completion.

observations: The durable source and CI receipt prerequisites are now available, so the next useful unit should measure behavior rather than add another storage-only mechanism.
The existing behavioral-outcome path already provides immutable precommit, Work binding, deterministic judgment, and replay verification.
Revision 20 requires every result to remain scoped to the exact tested cases, provider/configuration, and conditions.
local_learn.reason: The active strategy already prioritizes useful behavioral and outcome change after admissible receipts exist; this unit exercises that policy without changing it.

evidence_needed: a prepare-time digest and immutable request for each of the three cases before any child answer
three identity-bound Work child requests whose visible payload contains the task and behavioral-outcome binding but not the expected answer
three immutable child responses and exact-canonical judgments
a verified ledger update and replay verification for all three receipts
the exact candidate, provider identity status, task construction, rubric, authority generation, and execution conditions used by this measurement
expected_outputs: three verified behavioral-outcome receipts and their pass/fail vector
a bounded result artifact that distinguishes measured cases from untested behavior
explicit confirmation that expected answers were absent from each child's visible request
no duplicate positive-control reproduction when provenance-equivalent control evidence already exists
a continuation to Task Evaluate without treating internal provider behavior as independent production evidence or user-objective completion
failure_conditions: an expected answer, hidden scorer content, secret, or private reasoning appears in a child-visible request
a request, response, authority, identity, digest, timestamp, or ledger binding mismatch
generalizing a pass or failure to untested tasks, other providers, scientist-agent family members, or other mechanisms
relabeling internal behavioral evidence as AGI, independent production evidence, or completion of the user's upper objective
result.goal: Run one bounded three-case behavioral-outcome breadth measurement through the existing precommitted Work child path, with each exact-canonical rubric absent from the child's visible request, and record immutable request, response, judgment, and receipt evidence for the current provider under the current generation-9 authority.
inputs: the current generation-9 authority and acknowledged inbox revision 20
the existing internal behavioral-outcome ledger and its exact claim scope
three small mechanically judged tasks from distinct behavior categories whose expected answers are stored only in the sealed local rubric records and are not copied into child Work requests
result.parent_continuation: After the three bounded cases are recorded and verified, run Task Evaluate on only this exact measurement, then continue Candidate evaluation, Consolidate, Learn, and Root toward the still-unmet user objective.
result.rollback: On any contamination or binding mismatch, fail closed, preserve the immutable precommit and exact observed failure, do not synthesize a replacement answer, and return to Root with the narrow repair boundary.
success_conditions: all three cases are prepared before child execution and remain immutable
each response is bound to the exact frozen Work request and current authority
judgment is deterministic exact-canonical JSON and the ledger verifies without replay conflict
claims are limited to the three tested tasks, current provider/configuration, and recorded conditions
